body:
Direct C-target sibling of BURROW's burrow new. Generates a real starter (.prn + main.c + a local runtime copy), actually compiles+runs it before returning success. Built headless (PARENA_NO_GRAPHICS). New tests/integration/run_new_check.sh (make test-new). Live-verified: real scaffold builds+runs, correct output, overwrite refused. make test 345/345. Commit cafaf2f.
